[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd ledger

# A slow call inside a WithLock callback is no data race and no lint
# fault: the program is correct, and every other user of the value
# waits.
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./slow
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# The monitor names the WithLock call that holds the value and the call
# that waits for it. It prints the finding when the waiter comes, while
# the value is still held.
! logos conc run -hold 50ms ./slow
stdout '^balance 9$'
stdout '^.*slow[/\\]main\.lgo:16: \[conc::lock_held_long\] a goroutine held a Locked value for [1-3][0-9][0-9]ms while another goroutine waited for it; the limit is 50ms$'
stdout '^\t.*main\.lgo:16: this WithLock call holds the value$'
stdout '^\t.*main\.lgo:25: another goroutine waits for the value here$'
stdout '^\tfix: '
stdout -count=1 'lock_held_long'

! logos conc test -hold=50ms -count=1 ./slow
stdout '^ok '
stdout '\[conc::lock_held_long\]'

# The hold of 400ms is below a limit of 2s.
logos conc run -hold 2s ./slow
stdout '^balance 9$'
! stderr .
! stdout 'conc::'

# The same slow call outside the callback gives no finding.
logos conc run -hold 50ms ./quick
stdout '^balance 9$'
! stderr .
! stdout 'conc::'

! logos conc run -hold 0s ./quick
stderr '^logos conc run: -hold "0s" is not a positive duration$'
! stdout .

-- ledger/go.mod --
module example.com/ledger

go 1.27
-- ledger/slow/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"logos/sync"
)

type account struct{ balance int }

var ledger sync.Locked[account]

func audit() error {
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
		a.balance += 10
	})
	return nil
}

func pay() error {
	time.Sleep(150 * time.Millisecond)
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		a.balance--
	})
	return nil
}

func settle(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	go group (ctx) {
		go audit()
		go pay()
	}
	balance := 0
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		balance = a.balance
	})
	return balance, nil
}

func main() {
	balance, err := settle(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("balance", balance)
}
-- ledger/slow/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestSettle(t *testing.T) {
	balance, err := settle(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
		return
	}
	if balance != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("balance = %d, want 9", balance)
	}
}
-- ledger/quick/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"logos/sync"
)

type account struct{ balance int }

var ledger sync.Locked[account]

func audit() error {
	time.Sleep(400 * time.Millisecond)
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		a.balance += 10
	})
	return nil
}

func pay() error {
	time.Sleep(150 * time.Millisecond)
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		a.balance--
	})
	return nil
}

func settle(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	go group (ctx) {
		go audit()
		go pay()
	}
	balance := 0
	ledger.WithLock(a => {
		balance = a.balance
	})
	return balance, nil
}

func main() {
	balance, err := settle(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("balance", balance)
}
